name: Cervical Spine Fracture
definition: Traumatic fracture of one or more cervical vertebrae, ranging from stable injury to unstable fracture-dislocation with spinal cord risk.

redFlags.item: Any neurological deficit after cervical trauma

investigations.principle: CT is preferred in many high-risk adult trauma pathways; MRI assesses cord, disc and ligament injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Spinal precautions when instability is suspected
amber: Do not perform forceful manipulation until fracture/instability is excluded.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Abhighata/Bhagna concepts may be documented only after modern stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Traumatic fracture of one or more cervical vertebrae, ranging from stable injury to unstable fracture-dislocation with spinal cord risk.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
